title: Frevana Multiplayer
lede: Frevana, which runs AI agent apps for marketing, sales, research and operations, now lets a whole team share one workspace, so agents and skills one person builds can be reused by everyone.

points: Teammates join a shared workspace through an invite link and work alongside the team's agents in one place.
Skills, apps and set-up practices are configured once and then available to the whole team.
People can pick up a task where a colleague or an agent stopped, working on the same artifact.
The launch comment says Multiplayer is available to every existing user from launch day.
Commenters asked whether edits to a shared skill reach everyone, whether anyone is notified, and whether sharing an agent also shares its connected tool accounts.

sections.text: Small teams in marketing, sales, research or operations that already run AI agents and want one person's working workflow reused across departments instead of written up in a doc.
